_comment: T14.63: the question before exporting a meeting again, since a re-export replaces the whole Obsidian note. earshot_runtime::export (the CLI prints `single` and goes ahead) and the UI's one copy (detail/reexportCopy.ts) say them; both suites check against this table, so a copy change edits it. `batch_many` holds {count}, the number of the chosen meetings exported before.
single: This meeting has already been exported. Exporting again replaces the whole note, including anything you ticked, changed or added there.
batch_one: 1 of these meetings has already been exported. Exporting again replaces its whole note, including anything you ticked, changed or added there.
batch_many: {count} of these meetings have already been exported. Exporting again replaces their whole notes, including anything you ticked, changed or added there.
